c74object.name: j.node
c74object.digest: Declare a node that holds no value
c74object.description: j.node declares a node below the model of its patcher. It holds no value; its priority orders the initialisation of the parameters below it among the siblings of the node.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: The name of the node, relative to the model.

method.name: dump
method.description: The dump message answers the attributes out the rightmost outlet.

attribute.name: description
attribute.description: A textual description of the node.

attribute.name: priority
attribute.description: Orders the initialisation of what is below the node among its siblings.

attribute.name: tags
attribute.description: Accepted so that old patchers load; it has no effect yet.
